intro.title: Dental Implants in Istanbul – Master Smile Studio Turkey
intro.whatIsP1: A dental implant is an artificial tooth root that replaces a missing tooth. It looks like a small screw, usually made of titanium, and is placed into the jawbone to hold a new tooth securely. For a full tooth replacement, three main parts are used:

parts.title: Abutment
parts.desc: connects the implant to the crown.

parts.title: Crown
parts.desc: the visible part that looks like a natural tooth.

intro.healingP: Once the implant has healed and bonded strongly with the bone, the crown is made and attached. At Master Smile Studio in Istanbul, our expert team specializing in oral surgery ensures a seamless and high-quality dental implant procedure to restore your smile.
intro.solutionP: If you are missing one or more teeth, dental implants in Istanbul can be a safe, long-lasting, and aesthetic solution.

rightTreatment.heading: Find the Right Treatment for You
rightTreatment.subtitle: Not sure which dental treatment suits your needs? Browse through our treatment options to see who each procedure is for and what it offers so you can make informed decisions about your dental care.

fullMouth.title: Full Mouth Implants
fullMouth.target: Patients who have no teeth left in their upper and lower jaws
fullMouth.desc: It is a full mouth restoration where all teeth are fixed with implants.

allOn4.title: All-on-4 Implants
allOn4.target: Patients who are toothless or have teeth that need to be extracted, and who want fixed teeth in a short time.
allOn4.desc: A fixed prosthesis is made with 4 implants; it can also be applied to those with insufficient jawbone.

allOn6.title: All-on-6 Implants
allOn6.target: Toothless patients who want stronger jaw support.
allOn6.desc: A more durable and long-lasting fixed prosthesis is made with 6 implants.

immediate.title: Immediate Implant Treatment
immediate.target: Patients who have just had a tooth extracted and want an implant without losing time
immediate.desc: The implant is placed in the same session as the tooth extraction, which saves time.

zygomatic.title: Zygomatic Implants
zygomatic.target: Patients with bone loss in the upper jaw where traditional implants cannot be placed
zygomatic.desc: These are special implants placed in the cheekbone. A bone graft is not required.

zirconium.title: Zirconium Implants
zirconium.target: Those with metal allergies or high aesthetic concerns
zirconium.desc: It is a biocompatible implant type that is aesthetically closest to a natural tooth.

dentures.title: Implant Supported Dentures
dentures.target: Toothless patients or those who use dentures but want a fixed solution
dentures.desc: It is a more stable and comfortable solution compared to removable dentures.

sinusLifting.title: Sinus Lifting
sinusLifting.target: Patients who do not have enough bone volume in the upper jaw for an implant
sinusLifting.desc: The ground is prepared for the implant by adding bone powder to the sinus area.
